description:
Change a saved Radar report: rename it, replace its subjects, or change its period, sources, sort, episode cap, omitted sections or hidden episodes. Only the fields you pass change. `subjects` replaces the whole list, so pass every subject the report should keep. Setting `period` clears an explicit from/to range, and setting from/to clears the period.

Every member of the project's organization sees the change. Returns the updated report and its Radar link.

episode_cap.description: Most episodes listed per subject (25, 50 or 100). Defaults to 25 on create.

from.description: Start of an explicit period (YYYY-MM-DD). Requires to.

hidden_episodes.description: Episode ids to leave out of the report's mention lists. On update, replaces the set; pass an empty list to show them all.

name.description: New name. An empty string titles the report from its subjects.

omitted_sections.description: Optional sections to leave out of the report. On update, replaces the set; pass an empty list to restore them all.

output_format.description: Output serialization. 'markdown' (default) returns the LLM-facing rendering. 'json' returns the structured payload as JSON text — use only for programmatic chaining where exact field extraction matters; the JSON shape is larger and noisier for an LLM to read.

period.description: Preset period: a number of days or months back (e.g. 30d, 3mo, 12mo) or all. Set this or from/to, not both. Defaults to 3mo on create.

sort.description: Order of each subject's mention list. Defaults to popularity on create.

sources.description: Which sources the report reads. Defaults to both on create.

subjects.description: Replacement subjects, one to four, in order. Replaces the whole list; omit to leave the subjects unchanged.

entity.description: Slug of a person, company or topic, from particle_entity_resolve, particle_person_resolve or particle_company_resolve. Set this or keyword.

keyword.description: A word or phrase matched against podcast transcripts, for something with no entity slug. Set this or entity.

label.description: Display name for the subject. Defaults to the entity's name or the keyword.

to.description: End of an explicit period (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive. Requires from.

name: particle_report_update
title: Particle Report Update
